title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken with Grilled Apple
description: A Caribbean-inspired dish with spicy jerk seasoning and a sweet apple glaze, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together jerk seasoning, apple cider vinegar, and 2 tbsp of coconut oil.
Rub the mixture all over the chicken breast.
Place the chicken on the grill and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, brush the sliced apple with the remaining coconut oil and grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
Serve the chicken with grilled apple and onigiri on the side.
